about: Country cards for lives born in Ethiopia. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Ethiopia (ET) ===================== Equb (iqub): members pay in regularly and take the pot in turn, often by lottery (Wikipedia "Equb"; Addis Standard). Risk ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your neighbours run an equb: members pay in every month, and each month the pot goes to one member, drawn by lot, until everyone has had a turn.

zh..x: 邻居们办了一个互助会（equb）：会员每月交钱，每月抽签由一人拿走会钱，直到每个人都拿过一次。

zht..x: 鄰居們辦了一個互助會（equb）：會員每月交錢，每月抽籤由一人拿走會錢，直到每個人都拿過一次。

events.src: Idir (edir): a community burial association; families pay small monthly dues and the idir pays for funerals and lends tents and cooking equipment (Wikipedia "Eder (finance)"; Addis Fortune). Dues, the funeral cost and the share covered are ESTIMATES.

go.do: idir = j; if (j) { T('et_idir', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.et_idir'), paid: 0, saved: 0, nk: 'note.idir' }); rec('et_idir', a, 45); } later(age + 3 + Math.floor(roll('idirAt') * 20), 'idir', {})

later.idir: const c = .3 * base, cov = idir ? .8 * c : 0; pay(c - cov); happy -= 4; const t = T('et_idir', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.et_idir'), paid: 0, saved: 0, nk: 'note.idir' }); t.v -= c - cov; t.saved = (t.saved || 0) + cov; t.note = M('note.idir', { a: MN(t.paid || 0), b: MN(t.saved) }); log(M(idir ? 'log.idirHelp' : 'log.idirNo', { a: MN(c), b: MN(cov) }), 'bad')

en..x: Your neighbourhood idir is a burial association: each household pays small monthly dues, and when a family member dies the idir pays towards the funeral, lends tents and cooking pots, and members come to help.

zh..x: 你们社区的互助丧葬会（idir）：每户每月交一点会费，家里有人过世时，会里出钱办丧事，借出帐篷和锅具，会员也会来帮忙。

zht..x: 你們社區的互助喪葬會（idir）：每戶每月交一點會費，家裡有人過世時，會裡出錢辦喪事，借出帳篷和鍋具，會員也會來幫忙。

events.src: Inflation: above 30% in 2023; after the July 2024 float the birr fell from about 57 to 128 per dollar by December 2024 (Ethiopian Economics Association, via The Reporter; Dabafinance). The yearly loss is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Inflation was above 30% in 2023, and after the birr was floated in July 2024 it fell from about 57 to 128 per dollar within six months. Money left in birr loses value.

zh..x: 2023年通胀率超过30%；2024年7月比尔开放浮动后，半年内从约57比尔兑1美元跌到128比尔。存在比尔里的钱会缩水。

zht..x: 2023年通膨率超過30%；2024年7月比爾開放浮動後，半年內從約57比爾兌1美元跌到128比爾。存在比爾裡的錢會縮水。

events.src: Community-based health insurance: a household premium of 240 birr a year under the national guideline (some districts 400–530 birr), 827 of about 1,100 districts covered in 2020 (Dove Press review; Frontiers in Public Health, 2022). Share covered: ESTIMATE.

en..x: Community-based health insurance covers most districts: a household pays a small yearly premium (240 birr under the national guideline, more in some districts), and the poorest families are covered for free.
en..join.h: It pays about 55% of your medical bills.

zh..x: 社区医疗保险覆盖大多数地区：每户每年交一点保费（国家标准为240比尔，有些地区更高），最贫困的家庭免费。

zht..x: 社區醫療保險覆蓋大多數地區：每戶每年交一點保費（國家標準為240比爾，有些地區更高），最貧困的家庭免費。

events.src: Condominiums: the 20/80 and 40/60 schemes need a 20% or 40% down payment saved at the Commercial Bank of Ethiopia, the rest over 20 years; homes are allocated by lottery and many savers have waited over a decade (Addis Fortune; The Reporter; Capital Ethiopia). Savings earn less than inflation; the subsidised price (about 0.6 of market) and yearly odds are ESTIMATES.

go.do: condoOn = 1; yearly('et_condo', { amt: a, until: age + 15 }, { rate: -.04 }, 'trk.et_condoS'); later(age + 3, 'condo', { dp, p, until: age + 15 })

later.condo: if (house) { condoOn = 0; return } if (roll('condo' + age) < x.p) { const P = .6 * price(), l = lots.et_condo, sv = l ? l.v : 0; if (l) { l.v = 0; l.tout += sv; cash += sv } stopYearly('et_condo'); condoOn = 0; buyAt(P, {val: price(), dp: x.dp, fee: .01, r: .0, n: 20, lk: 'trk.et_condo', fixed: true, flex: true}); log(M('log.condoWin'), 'good') } else if (age < x.until) later(age + 1, 'condo', x)

en..x: In Addis Ababa you can register for a government condominium: save towards a 20% (20/80) or 40% (40/60) down payment at the Commercial Bank of Ethiopia, and homes are given out by lottery. Many savers have waited more than ten years.
en..s20.s: Save about {a} a year at the bank.
en..s20.h: A small chance each year of winning a home.
en..s40.s: Save about {a} a year at the bank.
en..s40.h: A better chance each year, with a bigger down payment.

zh..x: 在亚的斯亚贝巴，你可以登记政府公寓：在埃塞俄比亚商业银行存够20%（20/80方案）或40%（40/60方案）的首付，房子以抽签分配。很多人已经等了十年以上。
zh..s40.h: 首付较多，每年抽中的机会较大。

zht..x: 在阿迪斯阿貝巴，你可以登記政府公寓：在衣索比亞商業銀行存夠20%（20/80方案）或40%（40/60方案）的頭期款，房子以抽籤分配。很多人已經等了十年以上。
zht..s40.h: 頭期款較多，每年抽中的機會較大。

events.src: The Grade 12 exam: 8.4% of the 585,882 students who sat it in 2024/25 passed (50% or more), up from 5.4% (The Reporter). Effects of tutoring are game rules.

opts.do: addSkill('school', 1, M('trk.school')); cash += .05 * base; earned += .05 * base

en..x: Next year you sit the Grade 12 national exam, now taken at universities under strict supervision. Only 8.4% of the 585,882 students who sat it in 2024/25 scored the 50% needed to pass.
en..tutor.s: Your family pays for a tutor. Hard months: Happiness −3.
en..work: Help with the family business too

zh..x: 明年你要参加十二年级全国会考，现在都在大学里严格监考。2024/25年度参加的585,882名学生中，只有8.4%考到及格所需的50分。
zh..tutor.s: 家里付家教费。辛苦的几个月：幸福感 −3。

zht..x: 明年你要參加十二年級全國會考，現在都在大學裡嚴格監考。2024/25年度參加的585,882名學生中，只有8.4%考到及格所需的50分。
zht..tutor.s: 家裡付家教費。辛苦的幾個月：幸福感 −3。

events.src: The Ethiopian Securities Exchange opened in January 2025; Ethio Telecom sold shares at 300 birr each (minimum 33 shares, 9,900 birr) to about 47,000 citizens and listed in May 2026 (Ethio Telecom; Capital Ethiopia; mystocks.africa).

en..x: The Ethiopian Securities Exchange opened in January 2025. Ethio Telecom sold shares to citizens at 300 birr each (at least 33 shares, 9,900 birr), and they began trading in May 2026.
en..buy.s: Put {a} in. Shares rise and fall.

zh..x: 埃塞俄比亚证券交易所在2025年1月开业。埃塞电信以每股300比尔卖股票给国民（最少33股，9,900比尔），2026年5月开始交易。

zht..x: 衣索比亞證券交易所在2025年1月開業。衣索比亞電信以每股300比爾賣股票給國民（最少33股，9,900比爾），2026年5月開始交易。

events.src: Saudi Arabia resumed recruiting Ethiopian domestic workers in March 2023 through its Musaned platform, with recruitment fees (paid by employers) capped at SR6,900 and a minimum salary of SR1,000 a month under the 2017 labour agreement (Migrant-Rights.org; The Reporter). Pay and cost multiples and the travel and training costs are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.

en..x: A licensed agency offers a two-year job in Saudi Arabia at about {a} a year, with food and housing. Your neighbour’s daughter went last year.

zh..x: 一家合法仲介提供去沙特的两年工作，年薪大约{a}，包吃住。邻居的女儿去年去了。

zht..x: 一家合法仲介提供去沙烏地的兩年工作，年薪大約{a}，包吃住。鄰居的女兒去年去了。

events.src: Savings and credit cooperatives (SACCOs) are common at workplaces: members save a share of pay each month, earn a dividend and can borrow a multiple of their savings (Cooperative Societies Proclamation 985/2016; Federal Cooperative Agency). Rates, the dividend and the loan are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.

en..x: Your workplace has a savings and credit cooperative. Members save every month, and after a few years can borrow three times what they have saved.
en..join.s: About {a} a year from your pay.
en..join.h: A small dividend, and a cheap loan later.

zh..x: 你们单位有个储蓄信用合作社。社员每个月存钱，几年后可以借到存款三倍的钱。
zh..join.h: 有一点股息，以后还能借到便宜的贷款。

zht..x: 你們單位有個儲蓄信用合作社。社員每個月存錢，幾年後可以借到存款三倍的錢。
zht..join.h: 有一點股息，以後還能借到便宜的貸款。

events.src: SACCO loans of a multiple of members’ savings, often used to build rooms to rent out (Federal Cooperative Agency; ESTIMATE). Rent, cost and repayments are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('et_loan', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.et_loan')}); rec('et_loan', .2 * base, 6); T('et_room', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.et_room')}); rec('et_room', -.25 * base, 20); happy += 1

en..x: You can now borrow three times your SACCO savings. A builder says he could add two rooms behind your family’s house to rent out.
en..build.s: Repaid at about {a} a year for six years.
en..build.h: The rent covers the loan and then some, for years.

zh..x: 你现在可以借到互助社存款的三倍。有个工头说可以在你家后面加盖两个房间出租。
zh..build.h: 租金付得了贷款，还有剩，能收好多年。

zht..x: 你現在可以借到互助社存款的三倍。有個工頭說可以在你家後面加蓋兩個房間出租。
zht..build.h: 租金付得了貸款，還有剩，能收好多年。

events.src: Addis Ababa’s Corridor Development Project: demolitions in Piassa in early 2024 displaced thousands of households, some with five days’ notice, who were offered condominiums or kebele houses by lottery; Amnesty International found at least 872 people forcibly evicted in Bole and Lemi Kura in November 2024 (Amnesty, Apr 2025); condominium down payments of about Br120,000 exceeded many families’ compensation (Addis Fortune). Prices and effects are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.

opts.ok: liq >= .23 * .6 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.23 * .6 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(.6 * P, { val: .8 * P, dp: .2, fee: .03, r: .03, n: 20, lk: 'trk.et_condo2' }); happy -= 2; rl(-2)
T('et_far', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.et_far')}); rec('et_far', -.04 * base, 5, -.4); happy -= 3; rl(-2)
T('et_near', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.et_near')}); rec('et_near', .1 * base, 5); happy -= 1

en..x: A notice on the door: your neighbourhood is to be cleared for the new corridor within weeks. Tenants must find somewhere else.
en..condo: Enter the condominium lottery and buy one
en..condo.s: A down payment of about {a}, far out of the centre.
en..condo.h: A home of your own, but Happiness −2 and the neighbours are scattered.
en..far: Rent on the edge of the city
en..far.s: Cheaper rent and long minibus rides.
en..far.h: Happiness −3, Health a little lower each year from the commute.
en..near: Rent near the centre at the new prices
en..near.s: About {a} a year more in rent.
en.trk.et_far: Rent saved on the edge of the city

zh..x: 门上贴了通知：几周内你们这一带要拆掉，改建新的城市廊道。租户得另找地方住。
zh..condo.s: 头期款大约{a}，离市中心很远。
zh..condo.h: 有了自己的房子，但幸福感 −2，老邻居都散了。
zh..far.s: 房租便宜，但要坐很久的小巴。
zh..far.h: 幸福感 −3，通勤让健康每年少一点。
zh..near: 照新价钱在市中心附近租

zht..x: 門上貼了通知：幾週內你們這一帶要拆掉，改建新的城市廊道。租戶得另找地方住。
zht..condo.s: 頭期款大約{a}，離市中心很遠。
zht..condo.h: 有了自己的房子，但幸福感 −2，老鄰居都散了。
zht..far.s: 房租便宜，但要坐很久的小巴。
zht..far.h: 幸福感 −3，通勤讓健康每年少一點。
zht..near: 照新價錢在市中心附近租

events.src: The US Diversity Visa lottery: entering is free online, successful entrants are never told by letter or email, and paid “agents” have misled applicants and charged high fees (US State Department fraud warning; PolitiFact on a 2007 government report naming Ethiopia). The chance of selection (about 1.5%) and the agent’s fee (Br8,000 ≈ 0.07) are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.

en..x: The US green-card lottery is open. An internet café owner offers to enter you “with a better chance” for a fee.
en..self.h: About one entrant in seventy is selected.
en..agent: Pay the café owner to enter you
en..agent.h: Nobody can improve your odds; some agents keep entrants’ results to charge more.

zh..t: 美国多元移民签证抽签
zh..x: 美国绿卡抽签开放报名了。一家网咖老板说收点钱就能帮你报名，“中签机会更大”。
zh..self.h: 大约七十个人里有一个中签。
zh..agent.h: 没人能提高中签率；有些中介会扣住结果再加收费用。

zht..t: 美國多元移民簽證抽籤
zht..x: 美國綠卡抽籤開放報名了。一家網咖老闆說收點錢就能幫你報名，「中籤機會更大」。
zht..self.h: 大約七十個人裡有一個中籤。
zht..agent.h: 沒人能提高中籤率；有些仲介會扣住結果再加收費用。

events.src: Selected entrants must apply and pay visa and medical fees, and travel at their own cost (US State Department). Pay and cost multiples in the United States are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.

en..x: You check the State Department website and can hardly believe it: you have been selected for a US immigrant visa. Work there could pay about {a} a year.
en.trk.et_dv2: A new life in the United States

zh..x: 你上美国国务院网站一查，简直不敢相信：你中了美国移民签证。在那边工作年薪大约{a}。

zht..x: 你上美國國務院網站一查，簡直不敢相信：你中了美國移民簽證。在那邊工作年薪大約{a}。

events.src: Private school fees in Addis Ababa rose fast with inflation; in 2024 the city’s regulator capped increases at 40–65% for 1,227 private schools after most asked for 100–263%, and fees can top Br6,500 a month (Addis Fortune, Jul 2024). Br6,500 a month for ten months ≈ 0.54 of the game’s yardstick. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage. Bursary odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('et_school', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.et_school')}); rec('et_school', .54 * base, 6); kidWin(.15, .7)

en..x: Your child’s private school has raised its fees by two-thirds. The public school down the road is free but has seventy pupils to a class.
en..private: Keep them at the private school
en..private.h: Some of its pupils later win university scholarships.
en..public: Move them to the public school
en..public.h: A smaller chance of a scholarship later.

zh..x: 孩子的私立学校学费涨了三分之二。路口的公立学校免费，但一班有七十个学生。
zh..private.h: 有些学生以后能拿大学奖学金。
zh..public.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会比较小。

zht..x: 孩子的私立學校學費漲了三分之二。路口的公立學校免費，但一班有七十個學生。
zht..private.h: 有些學生以後能拿大學獎學金。
zht..public.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會比較小。

events.src: Telebirr Mela: since 2022 Ethio Telecom and Dashen Bank lend small amounts through the telebirr app without collateral, scored on phone and payment history (up to Br2,000 a day and Br10,000 a month at launch), alongside the Endekise overdraft (Ethio Telecom; Capital Ethiopia). The fee and the effect are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.

en..x: The rent is due on Monday and you are {a} short. Telebirr offers you a small loan on your phone.
en..mela.s: In your wallet in a minute.
en..mela.h: A service charge of about a tenth.
en..iqub: Ask your equb for an early draw

zh..x: 星期一要交房租，你还差{a}。Telebirr在手机上提供小额贷款。
zh..iqub: 请储蓄会让你提早领钱

zht..x: 星期一要交房租，你還差{a}。Telebirr在手機上提供小額貸款。
zht..iqub: 請儲蓄會讓你提早領錢

events.src: Coffee: Ethiopia earned a record $2.65 billion from 468,967 tonnes of coffee exports in 2024/25 (Ethiopian Coffee and Tea Authority, via Food Business MEA), as Arabica prices rose from about 270 to 423 US cents a pound between May 2024 and April 2025; reforms since 2017 let producers and cooperative unions export directly. The price paths, membership fee and effects are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.

en..x: World coffee prices are the highest in decades. A collector offers cash for your red cherries today; a cooperative union nearby exports directly.
en..sell: Sell red cherries to the collector
en..dry.s: More work, and a bet on prices.
en..dry.h: Often about 20% more, but prices can fall.
en..union.h: Direct exports pay about 8% more, year after year.

zh..x: 国际咖啡价格创下几十年来的新高。收购商今天就能付现金买你的红咖啡果；附近的合作社联社可以直接出口。
zh..sell.s: 今天拿现金，照他的价钱。
zh..dry.s: 比较辛苦，赌价格会更好。
zh..dry.h: 常常能多赚两成，但价格也可能下跌。
zh..union.h: 直接出口每年都能多大约8%。

zht..x: 國際咖啡價格創下幾十年來的新高。收購商今天就能付現金買你的紅咖啡果；附近的合作社聯社可以直接出口。
zht..sell.s: 今天拿現金，照他的價錢。
zht..dry.s: 比較辛苦，賭價格會更好。
zht..dry.h: 常常能多賺兩成，但價格也可能下跌。
zht..union.h: 直接出口每年都能多大約8%。

events.src: Rent control: the Residential House Rent Control and Administration Proclamation No. 1320/2024 requires written rent contracts registered with the authorities, sets a minimum term of two years and lets a regulator set allowed increases; Addis Ababa’s Directive 7/2024 makes demanding more rent than the registered contract unlawful (Dablo Law Firm; The Reporter). Renewal is not guaranteed. The increase and odds are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.

en..x: Your landlord says the rent goes up by half next month. Your contract is only a handwritten note.
en..register: Insist on a registered two-year contract at the legal rate
en..register.s: The new rent law is on your side.
en..register.h: Happiness −1 from the argument; some landlords find another tenant instead.

zh..x: 房东说下个月房租要涨一半。你们的合约只是手写的一张纸条。
zh..register: 坚持签登记过的两年合约，照法定涨幅
zh..register.s: 新的租赁法站在你这边。
zh..register.h: 吵一架，幸福感 −1；有些房东会改租给别人。

zht..x: 房東說下個月房租要漲一半。你們的合約只是手寫的一張紙條。
zht..register: 堅持簽登記過的兩年合約，照法定漲幅
zht..register.s: 新的租賃法站在你這邊。
zht..register.h: 吵一架，幸福感 −1；有些房東會改租給別人。

events.src: Weddings: Ethiopian weddings traditionally host hundreds of guests over several days, with a feast, a hall and a video, and guests and relatives often contribute through gifts or a wedding committee; with high inflation many couples now hold smaller ones (custom; news reports). Costs and contributions are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with Br10,000 a month (Br120,000 a year), between the civil-service minimum of Br6,000 and degree-holder entry pay of Br11,500 from September 2025 (Federal Civil Service Commission, via AllAfrica, Aug 2025): an ESTIMATE of a typical wage.
